profile.legalName: Boys & Girls Clubs Of Oakland Inc
profile.summary: A nonprofit youth organization in Oakland, California. It runs after-school programs, summer and break programs, academic and leadership development, arts and sports activities, and a dental clinic for Oakland youth.

sources.title: Boys & Girls Clubs Of Oakland Inc - Nonprofit Explorer - ProPublica

review.notes: ProPublica confirms Boys & Girls Clubs Of Oakland Inc as an Oakland, CA 501(c)(3) (EIN 94-1279794), and the organization's website confirms after-school and summer programs plus the contact details and programs in the neutral summary, matching OUSD's summer learning programs agreement. The site does not mention OUSD directly, but the name, city and service match is unambiguous.
